info.name: Azure Monitor Diagnostic Settings API
info.description:
Configure diagnostic settings to route platform logs and metrics from Azure resources to destinations such as Log Analytics workspaces, Storage Accounts, and Event Hubs.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Azure Support

item.name: Azure Monitor Create or update a diagnostic setting

variable.description: (Required) The name of the diagnostic setting.

request.description: Creates or updates diagnostic settings for the specified resource. Diagnostic settings determine where platform logs and metrics are routed.

response.name: Successful request to create or update a diagnostic setting.
